description: This file contains the implementation of the Captcha extension controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, including methods for managing, installing, and uninstalling captcha extensions, and generating lists of available captchas.

classes.name: Captcha
classes.description: Controller class for managing captcha extensions in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for listing available captcha extensions and their statuses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of available captcha extensions, their status, and actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a captcha extension, updates permissions, and registers necessary controllers, models and templates.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a captcha extension, updates permissions, and removes related data and controllers.
